''"I'm sorry, my name is Nari.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Nari|}} '''Nari''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi]]. In [[9 BBY]], after the [[Operation: Knightfall|destruction of the Jedi Order]], Nari was hiding on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] and helped the [[Unidentified saloon owner|owner]] of a [[Unidentified saloon|saloon]]. Rumors about him being a Jedi spread through [[the galaxy]], and three [[Inquisitor]]s went to Tatooine to capture him, but he managed to escape. Sometime later, he asked for help from former [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was also hiding on Tatooine, but the former Master told him to keep a low profile and live a normal life. Nari was later [[Death|killed]] by the Inquisitors and his body was [[Hanging|hung]] in the [[city]] of [[Anchorhead]]. ==Biography== ===Early life and Tatooine=== {{Quote|Prepare him for interrogation.|The Grand Inquisitor after capturing Nari|}} Nari was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Jedi]] who served the [[Jedi Order]]. In [[9 BBY]], ten [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Operation: Knightfall|destruction of the Jedi Order]], Nari was hiding on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]], storing his starship in the wastes of the planet. While on the planet, he helped an [[Unidentified saloon owner|individual]] who owned a [[Unidentified saloon|saloon]] in the [[city]] [[Mos Eisley]], but stories about him being a Jedi spread across [[the galaxy]]. In exchange for his help, the cantina owner allowed the Jedi to stay in his saloon. Eventually, [[the Grand Inquisitor]], a [[Pau'an]] male, heard the rumors and traveled to Tatooine along with fellow [[Inquisitor]]s [[Fifth Brother]] and [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] in order to capture him. [[File:NariUsesForce.png|thumb|left|300px|Nari used the Force to stop the knife.]] The three Inquisitors went into the saloon, and the Grand Inquisitor questioned the owner about the Jedi. While the Pau'an was talking, the Third Sister threw a [[knife]] toward the owner's head, but Nari, who was sitting at a table, used [[the Force]] to stop it, saving the man's life. The Third Sister ignited her [[lightsaber]], and the Grand Inquisitor ordered to prepare him for interrogation. Nari responded that they were wasting their time since they would have never been able to find all the remaining Jedi. The Third Sister tried to strike him with the lightsaber, but the Pau'an [[Telekinesis|stopped]] her with the Force, [[Force push|pushing]] her away. The Jedi took advantage of the moment to escape. ===Meeting Obi-Wan Kenobi and death=== {{Quote|You're looking for somebody else."''
''"What are you doing here, Obi-Wan?|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Nari|}} Sometime later, Nari saw former [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in a [[City|town]] on Tatooine, and he went looking for him in the [[desert]]. When the Jedi found him, Nari told Kenobi that he did not think he had survived, but Kenobi replied that Nari was making a mistake. The Jedi showed Kenobi his lightsaber, saying that there was no mistake. The former Jedi Master continued denying being Kenobi, but Nari begged him for help and told him that he was being hunted by the Inquisitors. Kenobi told him to bury his lightsaber in the desert and go back to town to live a normal life. Nari tried to convince Kenobi to help him, mentioning the people that needed them, but Kenobi said they had lost and rode away on his [[eopie]]. [[File:NariDead-OWKpI.png|thumb|right|300px|Kenobi looks on Nari's corpse in Anchorhead]] Nari was eventually captured and [[Death|killed]] by the Inquisitors, and his dead body was [[Hanging|hung]] in the city of [[Anchorhead]]. When Kenobi went to the town, several people were looking at his corpse in distress. The Jedi Master looked at him in sadness before going away. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|What happened to you? You were once a great Jedi.|Nari, to Obi-Wan Kenobi after he refused to help him|}} [[File:Nari.png|thumb|left|220px|Nari held to tenets of the Jedi code up until his death.]] Nari followed the [[Jedi Code]] even after the fall of the Jedi Order, and he risked his life to save an innocent, helping the cantina owner. Nari was convinced that the Inquisitors would have never been able to capture all the Jedi and tried to convince Kenobi to help him fight. After receiving a negative answer, Nari was disappointed and claimed that Kenobi was once a great Jedi, wondering what had happened to him. Nari had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], blue [[eye]]s, and fair skin. ==Powers and abilities== {{Quote|There.|The Third Sister after seeing Nari using the Force|}} As a Jedi, Nari was [[Force-sensitive]]. He used the Force to stop the knife thrown by the Third Sister. During the clash with the Inquisitors, Nari utilized the Force to drop the curtains of the cantina, facilitating his escape. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Um, there's no mistake.|Nari, to Obi-Wan Kenobi, after showing him his lightsaber|}} [[File:NariLightsaber.png|thumb|[[Nari's lightsaber]]]] While on Tatooine, Nari wore beige and blue [[robe]]s along with beige [[Clothing|trousers]]. He also had white [[boot]]s along with a beige [[scarf]]. As a Jedi, Nari carried a [[Nari's lightsaber|lightsaber]] with him. ==Behind the scenes== Nari was first pictured in the teaser trailer for the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' Disney+ series, which was released on [[March 9]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|TWTfhyvzTx0|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/teaser-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} He first appeared portrayed by [[Benny Safdie]] in the [[Part I|first episode]] of the series, which aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early.
